Load the merged timeseries table from any merged schema

Source: R/access_core.R
load_merged_ts.Rd

The merged schema is created by merge_sources() and contains ts, flat, and cohort_info tables pooled across all sources. Requires that the merge step has already been run.

Usage

load_merged_ts(
  schema,
  n = Inf,
  concepts = NULL,
  cols = c("all", "minimal"),
  cohort_only = TRUE,
  window_min = NULL,
  window_ref = c("admission", "icu"),
  con = NULL,
  case_adm_only,
  scope_only
)

Arguments

schema

Target schema name passed to merge_sources() (e.g. "rendehr", "trauma_project").

n

Max rows. Default Inf.

concepts

Optional character vector to filter concept_name column.

cols

Either "all" (default, every column) or "minimal", which keeps only the analysis essentials: ehr_id, source_data, the grain key (src_admission_id for an admission-level merge, src_icu_id for an ICU-level merge), concept_name, value, unit, and both time axes. Projection happens in SQL, so "minimal" also reduces transfer for large pulls.

cohort_only

If TRUE (default), return only rows of cohort members (cohort_index in the merged cohort_info), matched at the merge grain: (source_data, src_admission_id) for an admission-level merge, plus assigned_icu_id for an ICU-level merge (which needs cohort_info built with analysis_level = "icu"). Filter runs in SQL. FALSE reads all imported context rows; it cannot recover data that was never imported.

window_min

Optional c(from, to) in minutes, keeping rows with from <= time < to on the clock chosen by window_ref (applied in SQL). E.g. c(0, 1440) keeps the first 24 h. Rows with a missing time are dropped when a window is set. NULL (default) keeps all times. Unlike the bin-index window of load_merged_ts_wide(), this is in minutes.

window_ref

Clock for window_min: "admission" (default) uses time_since_hadm_min, "icu" uses time_since_icu_min.

con

Optional explicit DBI connection.

case_adm_only, scope_only

Removed; supplying either is an error. Use cohort_only.

Value

A data frame.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ts <- load_merged_ts("rendehr")
ts <- load_merged_ts("trauma_project", concepts = c("heart_rate", "sbp"))
ts <- load_merged_ts("rendehr", cols = "minimal")
ts <- load_merged_ts("rendehr", concepts = c("heart_rate", "map", "sofa"),
                     cohort_only = FALSE)

# First 24 h after hospital admission, filtered server-side
ts <- load_merged_ts("rendehr", concepts = c("lactate", "creatinine"),
                     window_min = c(0, 1440))
} # }
